items.headline: Celtic put one foot in the Champions League — 3-0 over LASK in Glasgow
items.body: Benjamin Nygren curled one into the top corner and summer signing Camilo Duran added a stunning volley and a poacher's second as Celtic ran LASK ragged in Glasgow. It's a huge cushion for the second leg — win it and they're back in the Champions League group stage.
items.say: Celtic 3-0'd LASK last night in the Champions League playoff — that new striker Duran is going to be a problem.

items.headline: The world No. 1 is out — a 20-year-old Czech qualifier just stunned Sabalenka
items.body: Sára Bejlek, ranked 35th, roared back from 5-1 down in the tiebreak and rattled off five straight games in the second set to knock top-seeded Aryna Sabalenka out 7-6(7), 6-4 in Cincinnati — her first-ever win over a top-ranked player, and the biggest upset of the US Open tune-up.
items.say: Sabalenka got upset in Cincinnati by a 20-year-old you've never heard of — the US Open's about to be wide open.

items.headline: Ohtani does it again — 30 homers for the sixth straight year
items.body: Shohei Ohtani crushed a 448-foot two-run shot into the Dodgers' bullpen at Coors Field, hitting his 30th of the season and joining a very short list of players ever to have six straight 30-homer campaigns. He's on a 22-game hit streak in Denver — 10 homers, 26 RBIs — where he basically just doesn't make outs.
items.say: Ohtani hit his 30th this week — six years in a row of 30-plus. He's just… not a normal baseball player.

items.headline: One last dance at Zandvoort — F1's Dutch GP says goodbye this weekend
items.body: Formula 1 comes back from the summer break for the final Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort before it drops off the calendar. It's a Sprint weekend, rain is in the forecast, and 19-year-old rookie sensation Kimi Antonelli leads the drivers' title by a whopping 50 points over Lewis Hamilton. Local hero Max Verstappen is desperate for his first win of a rough season.
items.say: F1's back this weekend and it's the last-ever Dutch GP at Zandvoort — an Italian teenager is somehow running away with the title. Wild season.

items.headline: Rookie QB spotlight — the No. 1 pick suits up for the Raiders tonight in Houston
items.body: Fernando Mendoza, the first overall pick in April, gets his second preseason look — this time against the Texans' loaded defense on ESPN tonight. He was sharp in his debut (10-of-16, 97 yards, a TD to Jack Bech) and has been getting first-team reps in joint practices this week.
items.say: The Raiders' new rookie QB plays the Texans tonight — first overall pick, everyone's watching to see if he's the real deal.

items.headline: Peacemaker's back tomorrow — and yes, the dance number is even more unhinged
items.body: James Gunn's gleefully insane superhero comedy returns tomorrow on HBO Max, with first reviews out today praising John Cena's surprisingly heartfelt performance and calling it 'somehow even better' than Season 1. Also: a completely reshot opening credits dance sequence — because of course.
items.say: New Peacemaker drops tomorrow — critics say Cena's really good this season. And they redid the whole opening dance.

items.headline: A big-screen bedtime story — 'The Magic Faraway Tree' opens Friday
items.body: Andrew Garfield, Claire Foy and Nicola Coughlan headline a live-action adaptation of the beloved Enid Blyton fantasy: a modern family moves to the countryside and discovers a giant tree whose branches climb into constantly-changing magical worlds. Perfect family theater day for a rainy August weekend.
items.say: There's a new family fantasy movie Friday — 'Magic Faraway Tree,' Andrew Garfield in it. Looks like a proper storybook adventure.

items.headline: Chelsea Wolfe's 'The Dark' lands Friday — with an assist from Tori Amos and NIN
items.body: Gothic-folk-metal favorite Chelsea Wolfe drops her ninth album on Loma Vista Friday — heavier and more direct than anything she's done, featuring guest appearances from Tori Amos and members of Nine Inch Nails and Queens of the Stone Age. Early reviews are calling it a career-best.
items.say: New Chelsea Wolfe album Friday — she's got Tori Amos and Nine Inch Nails on it. Really cinematic, moody stuff.

items.headline: Anthony Hopkins the composer — Sir Anthony's debut classical album is out Friday
items.body: Yes, Hannibal Lecter can compose. Sir Anthony Hopkins, 88, drops 'Life Is a Dream' on Decca Classics Friday — twelve of his original orchestral pieces spanning six decades, performed by the Philharmonia Orchestra under superstar conductor Gustavo Dudamel. He first studied piano at age four, before acting was ever on the table.
items.say: Did you know Anthony Hopkins composes classical music? He's got a full orchestral album out Friday — the conductor is Dudamel.
